## Checklist

- [ ] `bun run check` passes (format, lint, typecheck, unit tests with coverage)
- [ ] `bun run build` and `bun run test:e2e` pass, if the web app changed
- [ ] `cd android && ./gradlew test lint` passes, if the Android app changed
- [ ] New behavior has tests
- [ ] Docs are updated, if the behavior they describe changed
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has an entry under `## [Unreleased]`, for anything users will notice
- [ ] No secrets, device data or personal data are in the diff or the test fixtures
